introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a centralized firewall management system for a university that manages firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should allow authorized network administrators to create, review, update, and revoke firewall rules, enforce access restrictions between network segments, monitor blocked and allowed traffic, and generate alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The platform should maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions, provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events, and support multiple campus buildings.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The solution should be secure, scalable, reliable, and manageable.

functional.applicability_reason: Independent source obligations; unspecified choices remain TBD.

requirements.title: manage firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks in a centralized system
requirements.statement: The system shall manage firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks in a centralized system.

acceptance_criteria.given: system manages firewall policies across academic, administrative, research, hostel, and guest networks in a centralized system
acceptance_criteria.when: the system initiates policy management for any of the five network types
acceptance_criteria.then: the requested firewall policy is applied to the corresponding network segment with no observable deviation from expected behavior
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow authorized network administrators to create firewall rules
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized network administrators to create firewall rules.

acceptance_criteria.given: authorized network administrators create firewall rules
acceptance_criteria.then: the resulting firewall rule is visible in the system's active configuration
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow authorized network administrators to review firewall rules
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized network administrators to review firewall rules.

acceptance_criteria.given: authorized network administrators review firewall rules
acceptance_criteria.then: the current set of firewall rules is returned in full detail
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: allow authorized network administrators to update firewall rules
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized network administrators to update firewall rules.

acceptance_criteria.given: authorized network administrators update firewall rules
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated rule set reflects the changes made and is applied
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: allow authorized network administrators to revoke firewall rules
requirements.statement: The system shall allow authorized network administrators to revoke firewall rules.

acceptance_criteria.given: authorized network administrators revoke firewall rules
acceptance_criteria.then: the revoked rule is removed from active configuration and no longer applies
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: enforce access restrictions between network segments
requirements.statement: The system shall enforce access restrictions between network segments.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system enforces access restrictions between network segments
acceptance_criteria.when: an attempt is made to communicate across a restricted segment
acceptance_criteria.then: the communication is denied and no traffic is allowed through
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: monitor blocked and allowed traffic
requirements.statement: The system shall monitor blocked and allowed traffic.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system monitors blocked and allowed traffic
acceptance_criteria.when: traffic flow occurs in a network segment
acceptance_criteria.then: The system reports an observable result indicating the state of blocked and allowed traffic during network segment traffic flow.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: generate alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts
requirements.statement: The system shall generate alerts for suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts.

acceptance_criteria.given: the system detects suspicious or unauthorized communication attempts
acceptance_criteria.when: an anomalous connection pattern is observed
acceptance_criteria.then: the system generates an alert indicating the event and its characteristics
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

requirements.title: maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions.

acceptance_criteria.given: system maintains audit logs of firewall policy changes and administrative actions
acceptance_criteria.when: the system records a change to firewall policy or an administrative action
acceptance_criteria.then: the audit log contains a timestamped entry with the actor, action type, target resource, and change details
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting response

unresolved_decisions: Which fields must the audit logs contain?
What retention period is required for the audit logs?

requirements.title: provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events
requirements.statement: The system shall provide a dashboard for reviewing network security events.

acceptance_criteria.given: system provides a dashboard for reviewing network security events
acceptance_criteria.when: an administrator accesses the dashboard interface
acceptance_criteria.then: The administrator observes a dashboard displaying network security events upon accessing the interface.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state

requirements.title: support multiple campus buildings
requirements.statement: The system shall support multiple campus buildings.

acceptance_criteria.when: a user from a specific building initiates a network access request
acceptance_criteria.then: The system successfully routes network access requests from users in multiple campus buildings.
acceptance_criteria.observable_evidence: External test capture of the resulting state
